__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It sways back and forth contemplating whether or not to eat you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The huge python rears its head and hisses at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: python snake

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It looks harmless enough.  Or is it?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small green garter snake slithers along the floor.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: garter snake

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It looks completely harmless but who knows for sure?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small centipede here is looking for vegetation.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: centipede

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It looks ugly enough to scare its own mother.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An ugly kobold mumbles something under its breath.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: kobold

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You notice a slight tinge of madness in his eyes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: This orc is frothing around the mouth.  Better stay away.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: orc

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The orc says, "Whatcha look'n at?"
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: This large orc is looking for someone small to pick on.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: orc

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He's surely a strong, brainless fighter.  Like you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: This tall warrior has more scars than even you!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: warrior

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He seems to know his way with weapons.  And he wants
to show you what he can do!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: This veteran warrior is old enough to be your father.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: warrior

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Looking into the eyes of this poor soul makes you feel
sad as you see the terror and fear in its eyes.  Why
don't you put it out of its misery?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small beat-up hobgoblin cringes in the corner.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: hobgoblin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A closer look reveals a hungry demeanor.  Don't get too close!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A sickly brown snake watches you with caution.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: snake

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The centipede doesn't really seem to notice you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A white centipede crawls along the cave floors randomly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: centipede

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Red, bloodshot eyes and drool dripping from its mouth makes you
wonder just how far away you should be.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large hobgoblin is here wondering if he should tear you apart.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: hobgoblin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
As you already know, orcs have quite a ravenous appetite.
Care to be dinner?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An orc is here, looking for something (or perhaps someone) to eat.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: orc

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Huge claws and big teeth make quite a fearsome opponent for
the weary.  Are you next?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A mountain lion bears its teeth at the sight of more food.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: lion mountain

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The hill giant looks like he's about 9 feet tall. By his actions you
come to the conclusion that he's not very intelligent.  A perfect
playmate for you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A hill giant is here tossing rocks around.  Marbles perhaps?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: giant hill

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This guy can ace the SAT with his frontal lobe tied behind his back.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
A small intelligent looking mage is standing here. It looks like he
knows his way with magic.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Whilst you look at this troll, you realize he is trying to
figure just how tender you are.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: This large mean-looking troll wants to take a closer look at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: troll

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You take a closer look at this large snake while it tries to
bite your head off!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large green snake is guardian for something.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: guardian snake

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Well COUNT your money!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A thief, all dressed in black.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: thief

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Yrkk..  He belches in your face!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An ugly orc is standing here waiting for someone to practice on.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: orc

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It doesn't seem to pay any attention towards you.  You are probably
not important.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small harmless centipede is here looking for some vegetation to eat.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: centipede

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He doesn't look friendly at all...  He is no Mr. Rogers!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A human warrior grins an evil grin in your face.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: warrior

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It looks a little sick.  Something he ate maybe?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A green kobold hobbles along the cave walls puking periodically.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: kobold

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Bzzzt.  Zap.  Crackle.  Speak about static electricity!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A blue bat flies in circles while electrical charges arc here and there.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: bat blue

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You can definitely feel some heat from this thing.  A fever perhaps?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A red bat hangs upside down from the ceiling, glowing.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: bat red

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Whew!  What a stinker!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A green bat flies from wall to wall leaving an awful smell.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: bat green

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Brrr!  You almost can't distinguish this bat from an ice cube.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A white bat rests on the ceiling.  You wonder where the cold is coming from.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: bat white

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Amazing!  This bat is grooming itself with acid!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A black bat flies from wall to wall leaving something hissing behind.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: bat black

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He definitely knows what he's doing.  Trust him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A sneaky thief appears and disappears within the shadows.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: thief

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks quite mean.  Don't mess with him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large ugly troll is here mumbling something.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: troll

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
His little head is buried into his magic books.  He'd be very
angry should you bother his studies.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small man is here researching magical incantations.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: mage

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Sickly brown as it is, you know what it really wants is you
for dinner.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A brown snake hisses at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: snake

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He is so happy, you are disgusted.  Kill him now!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A 'small' troll is here happily dancing.  Trala-la-la.  La-la.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: troll

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He is just looking for a fight isn't he?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large orc growls in your face.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: orc
